description: This Java class defines a response object for a sudo retrieve things command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the retrieved 'things' data, provides methods to create instances from various input formats (JSON string, list of strings, list of Thing objects), and supports JSON serialization/deserialization. It is part of the 'commands.sudo' package, specifically handling the response to SudoRetrieveThings commands.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingsResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a sudo retrieve things command, providing various factory methods for instantiation and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create response from plain JSON string of things.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create response from a list of JSON strings representing things.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create response from a JsonArray of things.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create response from a list of Thing objects with optional predicate.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create response from a list of Thing objects with a JsonFieldSelector and predicate.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates response from a JSON string representing the response.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates response from a JsonObject representing the response.

methods.name: getThings
methods.description: Returns the list of Thing objects contained in the response.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity of the response from a JsonValue.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to a JsonObjectBuilder, respecting schema version and predicate.
